title: Addition of 2-Digit Numbers

meta_desc: Free Primary 2 maths worksheets on addition: addition facts to 20, adding tens, adding 2-digit numbers with and without exchanging, and adding three numbers. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Add the units, then the tens
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Add the units first. Then add the tens.
  • If the units make 10 or more, exchange 10 units for 1 ten.
  • You can add numbers in any order: 7 + 5 = 5 + 7.

Examples

Example

27 + 15

7 + 5 = 12, write 2, carry 1

2 + 1 + 1 = 4

Answer: 42

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting the carried tenAdd it to the tens.
Adding tens to unitsTens under tens, units under units.
Counting on from the wrong numberStart from the bigger number.

items.q: The blocks show 76. 3 tens are crossed out. What is 76 − 30?

items.q: Count on in tens. What is 45 + 30?

items.q: Count back in tens. What is 82 − 40?

items.q: To add 29 + 34, Kayode makes a ten. He moves 1 from 34 to 29. Which is the same as 29 + 34?
items.e: 29 + 1 = 30. Then 34 − 1 = 33. So 29 + 34 = 30 + 33 = 63. Moving 1 does not change the total.
